title: Performance Chronicle: model & route panel system for token/latency observability
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, scannable "chronicle" panel that surfaces per-model and per-route performance signals (latency distributions, throughput, token counts, and variance over time) at multiple densities: card, expanded panel, and full canvas. The goal is to reduce time-to-detect regressions while preserving context for on-call and SRE workflows.
goals: Single-pane glance for recent regressions (last 1h, 6h, 24h) across latency P50/P95/P99 and tokens-per-request
Fast transition from overview to microtrace for a specific route-model pair with preserved filter state
Ensure low visual density mode for secondary consoles (mobile/tablet) and printable PDF export for postmortem attachments
success_metrics: Reduce mean time to acknowledgement (MTTA) for performance incidents by 18% in experiment cohort
Increase frequency of proactive performance checks by platform SREs (tracked via console interactions) by 25%
Fewer false-positive alerts from noisy P50 spikes due to better percentile layering and token-weighted smoothing
chart_specs: Latency ribbon: stacked area showing P50/P75/P95/P99 bands for selected window; X-axis time, Y-axis latency (ms) on log scale; hover shows exact percentiles and sample count
Throughput sparkline: per-second RPS line with lightweight bar overlay for 95th-percentile request size; supports brushing to set zoom window
Token distribution histogram: normalized bucketed histogram of tokens-per-request with median and 90th percentile markers; toggles to show inbound vs generated tokens
Microtrace swimlane: compact horizontal timeline with request-level durations color-coded by stage (queue, decode, kernel, postprocess); supports keyboard navigation and jump-to-request
Delta ribbons: small-multiples showing relative change from baseline (baseline could be 7d avg); uses diverging color scale with carryover smoothing to avoid flicker
Cost-overlay layer: optional percent-cost-per-token shading on top of throughput/latency charts for quick cost-performance tradeoff visualization
Correlation matrix panel: downloadable CSV that lists top correlated signals (latency vs token size vs model variant) computed server-side; UI exposes top 5 correlations inline
visual_tokens_and_palette: Primary accent: Redwood teal #007B66 for selected routes/models
Degraded: Amber #FFB020 for drifting signals; Critical: Coral #FF5C5C
Neutral lines and grids: shades of gray with 4.5:1 contrast for axis labels; use darker strokes for hover/focus
Accessibility: all actionable color encodings paired with shape or pattern (e.g., stipple for cost overlay) to ensure color-blind friendliness
wireframes: Card state: 280x140px panel with miniature latency ribbon, throughput sparkline, and tokens median chip
Expanded panel: left column timeline charts, right column recent errors and top-correlated signals; supports in-panel comparisons across up to 3 model variants
Canvas mode: full-screen with filter bar, timepicker, and stacked panes for custom arrangements
interaction_flows: 1) From routes list, quick-expand on hover to show card state; keyboard shortcut 'E' toggles expansion to panel mode
2) Click on any percentile band to open microtrace swimlane filtered to that percentile's requests; brushing a region opens raw request list with jump links to request detail page
3) Apply baseline comparison via chevron menu; baseline can be custom date range or rolling 7d average; charts update with delta ribbons and contextual tooltips
accessibility_notes: All chart axes and controls are keyboard-navigable and expose ARIA labels with current values
Color encodings have redundant visual encodings (patterns/shapes) and pass WCAG AA for text and icon contrast
Tooltips are reachable via focus and include a condensed text version suitable for screen readers
review_feedback: 2026-02-22 - PM review (Jordan Lee): prefer median token chips be tappable to open token distribution histogram; agreed, added affordance
2026-02-26 - Eng review (Priya Nair): requested explicit max-series limits to avoid overloading render path for routes with many variants; decision to cap to 6 series with server-side summarization
2026-03-02 - SRE session (Victor Chen): suggested adding integrated alert-suggest links that prefill threshold suggestions based on recent volatility; added to next-steps
2026-03-08 - Design critique (Nora Kaplan): reduce reliance on stacked area opacity because it obscures micropeak events; updated spec to include toggle to discrete percentile lines
decisions: Use log-scale Y-axis for latency charts to surface tail behavior while preserving P50 readability
Limit small-multiples to 4 columns on wide screens, collapse into vertical stack on narrow screens
Server computes top correlations and sample counts; client renders only pre-aggregated slices to keep charts snappy
next_steps: Finish high-fidelity prototype and handoff components to engineering sprint next cycle
Work with backend to expose pre-aggregated percentile windows and correlation API endpoints
Implement accessibility QA pass and schedule 1-hr SRE usability session during Cycle 2026-W11
